notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: Weather effects show up again in Arcade mode

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: Fixed Some stones and logs not despawning when harvested

notes.title: Patch 1.16.3
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Skips in chapter 2 now work
 Sun and moon crystals now work on the correct slots
 Fixed a jump glitch in cave of illusion
 Auto life now works against death link

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Changes

 Hint man added in Ioto that will tell you secret information for a price
 Void does half damage now
 Auction will not sell licenses you already own
 Level increase in final dungeons if on hard mode
 New Cheat has been added
 Chests added in Sun and Moon Dungeons
 Spiders removed from bandit Hideout


Bug Fixes

 Sun And Moon dance no longer crash the game
 Some sprites have been adjusted
 Fixed some NPC's going invisible after or during a cutscene
 Quest Castle Breaker will now complete
 Fixed Interior of personal home
 Septova will now register in the Enemy Book after defeat

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Bug fixes

 Vaults are accessible now
 fixed soft lock in personal town
 Fixed getting gems out of order

notes.title: Patch 1.16
notes.content:
Changes

 Bosses have more weaknesses
 Wrath will no longer prioritise killing himself when in party
 Environment fixes
 Some scenes are more expressive
 Final boss has been tweaked
 Chapter 5 bosses have been given boss status
 Burn stacks to 250 now


Bug Fixes

 Alvis cooling skill no longer makes the enemy invincible
 Lag severely reduced in levels where the party splits
 Respawn has been adjusted so it doesn't fail during long games
 Revelin is more explorable thanks to some glitch fixes
 Game can support parties of up to 9 people

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Bug fixes

 Chimera quest can no longer be completed multiple times with 1 kill
 Mojo smithing now correctly counts stats

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Changes

 Bosses have a default resistance to status effects and are no longer immune depending on the boss


Bug Fixes

 Alvis no longer crashes the game when his unique skills get used
 Region gets updated when using the housing teleport
 Crafting is more accurate in terms of stats
 Game can handle parties up to 8 without encountering weird glitches (6 is still the max)

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Changes

 Undead no longer counter life-steal
 Removed EXP decay from quests
 Werewolf will use resist right away instead of after being afflicted
 Blood spike and miasma now have heal block


Bug Fixes

 Fixed infinity chest in bandit cave
 Envy now has the correct trigger once defeated
 A few quests had wrong information
 Shadow now correctly applies the dark element

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed more areas where the map goes blank
 Camille trait works in adventure mode now
 Chest in ice trail can now be open in the right direction
 Personal town will no longer give a blank screen
 Fixed a bridge in ancient valley that would sometimes block players

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Changes

 Economy checker is more aggressive at checking if prices are out of range
 Cheat codes are no longer case sensitive
 Crows have a drop rate of 99% for stolen items


Bug Fixes

 Crates are movable in Corvos cave
 Fixed sequence skip in chapter 2
 Fixed invisible wall in sewer
 S'hari doors properly lock
 Fixed people leaving cities

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Changes

 Adrenaline skill has been nerfed. No longer gain TP and can only use in battle
 Merchants no longer ask if you want to shop there, it just takes you straight to the shop selection
 All summoning souls have a proper description.


Bug Fixes

 Shooter bow is two-handed now
 Prevent soft lock in the light temple by making the first floor accessible

notes.title: Patch 1.15
notes.content:
Changes

 Lyndis woods had some graphic fixes
 Housing has been revamped
 More Quests have been added
 Quests now display money earned and reward is higher
 Quests have diminishing returns
 Weather skills have been nerfed. Less potent and longer cooldown. 


Bug Fixes

 sleeping in chapter one will correctly refresh merchant stock
 Merchants will give sales based on reputation
 Quests give out reputation points when completed
 A few areas had cave entrances that lead to nowhere, they have been removed
 Some crystals displayed the wrong graphic

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Changes

 Light skills get remove death link


Bug Fixes

 Turning your house into an inn will no longer crash the game
 The casino will deduct gold now when you lose

notes.title: Patch 1.14
notes.content:
Changes

 The final area has been doubled in size
 6 New Bosses have been added
 Cave of Illusion has been changed to make it easier to navigate
 Many more postgame areas have been added
 Hard mode bosses have 25% more health instead of 50%
 NPC's have more interesting dialogue in main towns
 Chapter 2 starts in a random season
 Lia's abilities have been slightly modified


Demo

 Demo has been updated to version 1.14
 Saves transfer to the full version of the game now


Bug Fixes

 Lia's Agility now has the proper growth rate
 Some dialogues now have more facial expression
 Some bosses have special music that will now play
 Areas that lead to nowhere have been removed
 Corvos soldier now uses the right moves
 Many small fixes such as grammar and incorrect text have been fixed

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed some incorrect text
 Sharpen can no longer miss
 Fixed glitched pillar in war room
 Shed is now unlockable in Hillsaw
 Moses portrait fixed in Hillsaw
 Fashion police will no longer revert to it's old sprite
 Small changes with the restaurant

notes.title: Patch 1.13
notes.content:
Changes

 Vert sells more stuff in chapter 1 so players do not have to depend on RNG as much
 A rope so a player can access a ledge in sunken woods
 Card buffs now last depending on card power
 Some battle backgrounds have been improved
 Hardcore no longer has save anywhere
 Hillsaw dog got a glowup
 Help page for status effects



Bug Fixes

 Chests will not open anymore if you do not have a key
 Crates and boxes no longer need a key to open
 Moira punish skill now targets enemies instead of allies
 Moira can not be seduced anymore since it caused lots of problems with her unique AI

notes.title: Update 1.12
notes.content:
Changes

 Cut Content, Mining outpost has been restored in Glacier Hills
 Side Quests are now dynamic so their rewards will increase based on player level
 You can now only turn in Quests at the correct region
 Trains and Boats have been added, Now you can get around in the later chapters and Conquest
 Corvos Housing price has been reduced at the start to avoid Housing prices to plummet
 A few caves have been added around the world
 Some scenes have been adjusted in Chapter 1 to flow better
 Hard mode fixed levels now go up in every chapter for dungeons
 Random encounters turned off for modern and hardcore mode
 The seer can no longer adjust enemy levels in hard mode
 Minable dark stones have been added
 Some dialogue has been fixed in chapter 4
 Ioto NPC's will give useful hints
 Another Owl has been added


Bug Fixes

 Many side quests have been fixed
 Unlocking Raine now counts toward character quest completion

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Changes

 Jamie has been nerfed so his skills no longer target all
 Final Dungeon now plays the correct song


Bug Fixes

 A scene near the end had the wrong trigger making players stuck depending on their choices
 Fixed some portraits where it displayed the wrong characters

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed some players not being able to move in the final dungeon
 Credits will no longer freeze at the title screen once over

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Wrong enemy in spoiler fight
 Fixed looping issue after spoiler fight
 Fixed not getting a key to fight bonus final boss

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 All routes now work instead of forcing you into the rebel route.
 Octavia is no longer invisible in the castle.

notes.title: Patch 1.11
notes.content:
Changes

 Changed the trigger for finishing chapter 4
 The weather no longer manipulates physical skill costs
 Cure bottle description updated to show that it cures burns



Bug Fixes

 S'hari glitch has been fixed so the town loads if entering diagonally
 Glitched items will be cleaned up from your inventory
 Soulstrum side quests can be selected
 Mimics will now copy the correct character
 Sun and moon crystals have unique names
 Many shortcut ladders have been fixed

notes.title: Patch 1.10
notes.content:
Changes

 Logs and stones now have a higher chance at giving more items
 NPC's in Corvos are no longer obsessed with Billy


Bug Fixes

 Fixed passability in cave of illusion and swamp shortcut
 Museum no longer gives out glitched items (You can sell anything they gave you)
 Bury skill now lowers agility
 Fixed glitching through the woods in Sunken Woods
 Fixed invisible sprites at end of chapter 2
 Blake and Kara no longer die randomly at the start of chapter 5
 If you lose at tower of mana in adventure/conquest it will no longer autosave upon death
 Signs at the earth temple are interactable
 It will no longer rain inside your home
 If home is an inn, you can now sleep at the front desk

notes.title: Patch 1.9
notes.content:
Changes

 Sign added to volcano to help give players more direction
 Fashion Police is no longer committing fashion crimes
 Physical attacks can no longer be interrupted
 Meditate now heals 3x more than it used to
 Soulstrum has less merchants
 A few more chests have been placed in Ashen Sands and Tiptuk Jungle.
 Splitting the party will now show merchants as a leader instead of Leon
 Some more flavour text is more consistent


Bug Fixes

 Many spots in the jungle could trap a player, this has been fixed
 Fire gem quest now completes itself
 Defeating the phoenix now removes its fire
 Alice passive now works on all her moves

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.content:
Fixed another spot where a player gets stuck in Octavia's room
 Fixed chests in the armory giving out infinite items

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Bug fixes

 Starting location for adventure no longer puts you in a window
 Measures have been taking to prevent crashes when splitting the party

notes.title: Patch 1.8
notes.content:
Changes

 Merchant gear requirements have been lowered by 10 levels
 Elemental gods will no longer spam their ultimate attack
 Virus crystal has been nerfed from 3% to 1%
 The royals can now sleep in their childhood beds


Bug Fixes

 Serah will no longer throw away her family heirloom
 Jellyfish will no longer trap the player in a death loop
 Glacius had some bad AI logic which made him use the wrong moves, this has been fixed
 Fixed a jumping section in Soulstrum sewer
 Measures have been made to prevent crashing when combining your party
 You now exit the correct house in Soulstrum
 A few bosses were glitched and not fighting back, this has been fixed
 Fixed the save anywhere setting from being overridden by statues and fish
 Fixed Mable and Alvis sprite not showing up in their recruitment cutscene
 Killian now says the proper dialogue when smithing
 Some side quests now have the proper description
 Mine cart now stays on the rails
 Hillsaw cows will no longer get loose
 If at war with a country soldiers will now appear on the fields
 A few more signs are interactable

notes.title: Patch 1.7
notes.content:
Changes

 Corvos Castle got a redesign to be less bland.
 Cursor for allies has been adjusted slightly.
 Patty has been nerfed and items no longer affect everyone.
 Songs are no longer limited use.
 Merchants are more likely to carry better gear earlier in the game.
 Smithing license now doubles your smithing points.
 Owls are only present at midnight.
 Better Dialogue in Shock Temple.
 Some items have better descriptions.


Bug Fixes

 Gems now allow teleporting again.
 All temple doors will start in a locked state.
 Water temple is no longer affected by day and night.
 Quests have been adjusted to be more accurate.
 Seashell Bay no longer gets you stuck after leaving home
 Fish now properly respawn
 Lootables in Soulstrum should work now as well as crafting stations
 Shack by the water temple no longer changes sprites at night
 Light boss can now be challenged in Conquest mode

notes.title: Patch 1.6
notes.content:
CHANGES

 A customizable town has been added
 Requirements for many titles have been made easier
 Samuel now has recruit requirements
 The coliseum has been made more in-depth
 A cave has been added to Selina Canyon
 Titles have different text


BUG FIXES

 Potential Softlock fixed when inserting coins in fallen sands
 Enemies in the battle tomb now can be defeated
 Lots of titles were not being granted to players after completing requirements
 Celina was never unlocking due to never calculating enemies discovered, this has been fixed

notes.title: Patch 1.5
notes.content:
Changes

 You can now toggle the HUD at the angel statue
 You can now select save anywhere at the angel statue
 Mushrooms area of effect has been reduced
 You can now craft crystals at the academy
 The icon for quests has been made more visible
 The trainer at the Academy and Soulstrum now have an icon
 Lucy, Aiden, Mala and Raven now have requirements to recruit
 Merchant dialogue has been improved
 There are more merchants in the world
 Reaper has been nerfed and can no longer regen health
 Coliseum has been added to Soulstrum
 Haunted mansion has been improved with more loot and better dialogue
 Quests are more accurate
 Elemental gods have been nerfed and can now be affected by debuffs
 Some cutscenes have been improved in Chapter 3 and 5
 Soulstrum now has an angel statue


Bug Fixes

 Missing files fixed at Academy museum, Swamp and Dark Temple
 Missing ladder fixed in the swamp
 Lust now says the correct dialogue
 Lust can now be killed
 Soulstrum sewer got some performance fixes
 Some quests in chapter 2 and 3 were not working correctly
 A spoiler boss only had 100 health, this has now been fixed
 If a town is on fire citizens will no longer hang around to watch the chaos
 Quest markers in chapter 3 were sometimes showing up in the wrong place, this has been fixed.
 The smuggler at the beginning of chapter 3 will no longer cause citizens to disappear after speaking with her
 A cut cutscene would play at the start of chapter 3, it has now been properly removed
 Some merchants had the wrong recruitment flags and would sometimes give you a different character
 You can now properly leave the mana tower after a boss battle
 Some of the crafting stations at Academy would pull up the wrong menu
 Crafting stations at Soulstrum now work
 Some areas had a long loading time, this has been fixed too

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.content:
CHANGES

 Soulstrum region has more chests and harvestable items
 You can now pay to rebuild the bridges in the swamp in Adventure
 Soulstrum field has been optimized to run faster
 The seer will now tell you what your current reputation is


BUG FIXES

 Ruin by the water temple will no longer corrupt saves or cause a crash.
 The craftable ladder in Ice Temple has been fixed
 Updated logic for some chests in the Soulstrum area so they reset properly after a month has passed.
 Fixed area in Swamp that didn't allow you to jump over to reach a chest

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
CHANGES

 Added character ending descriptions for all routes


BUG FIXES

 Fixed invisible enemies in Earth, Wind and Shock temple.
 Fixed ruins not being enterable in the jungle.
 Fixed auto skipping of dialogue in chapter 5
 Fixed missing portraits in chapter 5
 Fixed chest not appearing after fighting the demon in the shock temple
 Removed a few unused files
 Fixed abnormal portrait for the demon of Envy

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
BUGS

 Buying a house no longer corrupts saves, Previous saves that were corrupted should work again.
 Leaving the tower of mana in adventure/conquest will actually allow you to leave now.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Thanks to all, who have gotten around to playing Corvos Dynasty! Your feedback has been constructive in spotting what areas have trouble and what can be improved. Here is the first wave of bug fixes.

CHANGES

 If you fail a stealth section 3 or more times you can choose to skip it.
 Some dialogue has been modified to give the player a better sense of direction.


BUG FIXES

 The guard will now go back to his original spot after spotting the player in chapter 1
 chapter 3 had a major sequence break allowing you to skip a dungeon and character, that has now been patched.
 chests in the sunken forest have been updated with better logic.
 quests no longer break in chapter 3
 characters would sometimes turn invisible in cutscenes, this has been patched in a few places
 The map should be less likely to fail to load an area in Corvos
